bundle.shortDescription: A database viewer with an AI assistant that never runs anything on your database
bundle.longDescription: Contura is a desktop client for SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL with an object tree, a data grid, an SQL editor and a Schema Builder. Its AI assistant uses a provider you set up yourself, shows exactly what each question sends, and never runs anything on its own: you insert the SQL and press Run. Passwords and the AI key are kept in the OS keyring when one is available, otherwise only until Contura closes, and never in files.
